inspection_comments: No violations were observed at the time of the inspection. Gloves were available to prevent bare hand contact with ready to eat food items. No PHF cooked and or hot held food items were evaluated at the time of the inspection. Quaternary ammonia test strips were available to ensure the quaternary ammonia sanitizing solution is at the minimum concentration of 200ppm to sanitize both dishware/ utensils and food contact surfaces. The hand washing station was equipped with warm running water, soap, single use paper towels and required employee hand washing signage. Sanitarian advises required hand washing of at least 20 seconds under warm water with soap and the importance of washing hands in between glove changes and after using the restroom, drinking, eating, sneezing, smoking/ vaping, or when returning from a break and or any time after possible contamination. Sanitarian advises changing gloves after handling money or whenever there is a change in task before returning to food preparation. Observed the UV water disinfection system functioning normal at the time of the inspection. The facility's men's restroom was in compliance with the Food Service Establishment State Sanitary Code Sub-part 14.1, however, there are two toilets with wooden partitions between them lacking toilet seats and toilet lids that are considered urinals, CCHD to refer to Building and Code Enforcement for compliance.
